properties.note: Pre-reaction complex (ylide + formaldehyde), single dot-joined complex node; C...C 2.80 A, P...O 3.12 A. The loose complex is not a clean minimum: the only imaginary mode of the complex is a floppy intermolecular motion (-93.94 cm-1), reproduced independently in two runs; per-component minima are coord/ylide_optfreq.log (-382.264893733 Ha, 0 imag) and coord/hcho_optfreq.log (-114.417332518 Ha, 0 imag), complexation -8.7 kcal/mol.

Concerted [2+2] cycloaddition saddle on the RC -> oxaphosphetane path (bond formation is strongly coupled: C...C and P...O close together). B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP gas phase is extremely flat here; this is the only first-order saddle found along the path (every gradient TS search from C...C 1.93-2.05 / P...O 2.21-2.63 A funnels to it). Short IRC (forward) from this saddle descends monotonically back to the reactant-complex region (C...C 2.16 -> 2.38 A, P...O 2.84 -> 2.95 A, C=O 1.250 -> 1.227 A at +0.34 kcal/mol); the reverse side was not completed. The relaxed C...C scan gives an upper bound of +4.7 kcal/mol for the shoulder region.
Oxaphosphetane, 4-membered P-C-C-O ring, pentacoordinate P (P-C 1.870, C-C 1.535, C-O 1.412, P-O 1.784 A); verified minimum, lowest real mode 118.99 cm-1.
Retro-[2+2] cycloreversion saddle: C-O and P-C break while C=C (1.406 A) and P=O (1.566 A) close; C-O 1.868, P-C 2.390 A at the saddle. Imaginary mode pair projections: C...O 0.61, P...C 0.41.
Product complex ethylene + phosphine oxide; C=C 1.34, P=O 1.51, P...C 3.42 A; verified minimum (lowest mode 41.63 cm-1).
